notes: The official reference list of the national dental examination (آزمون ملی دانش‌آموختگان دندانپزشکی خارج از کشور), دی ۱۴۰۴ (دوره ۲۴), as published by the medical education assessment center (sanjeshp.ir, Content.aspx?click=26, section «ملی دندانپزشکی», row «منابع آزمون ملی دی ماه 1404- دوره 24»), transcribed row by row from its one-page table. The same center states that the 1405 sittings (دوره‌های ۲۵ و ۲۶) use this same list; The also_years field records it for 1405 too. Scopes are copied as printed, digits in Latin form. The English row is a scope statement, not a book.
